author: DamiLee
description:
The Colosseum had a secret hiding in plain sight, buried under the arena floor for nearly 2,000 years.

A two-level substructure called the hypogeum operated like a hidden backstage. Hundreds of workers, underground tunnels connecting to surrounding buildings, gladiators and animals moving unseen beneath the crowd's feet.

And then, on cue, more than 80 mechanical lifts would carry props, animals, and fighters up through the floor. Each one designed to snap open automatically the moment it reached the arena, releasing its contents into the light.

Every detail was engineered so that things would appear out of darkness. So that transformations felt magical to the people watching above.

The spectacle was never just in the arena. It was in everything they chose not to show you.
